card.name: Linking words inside general web sentences
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on assorted small linking words (of, are, more, into, in, a comma) in the middle of general encyclopedic or web prose.

modes.label: Linking words in prose
modes.description: Small words like of, into, in or are in the middle of an explanatory sentence, often about history, mathematics or society.
modes.example: established the significance<< of>> cryptography on and off the battlefield.

card.writes: Suppresses words about rise or trend (emergence, popularity, trend), and promotes some Chinese words about revising or enabling.
card.plain: It shows up on ordinary connecting words in general text and has no clear single meaning.
